facts.material: bi-metal (steel) toothed cutting edge; mandrels; carry case
facts.function: cutting round holes in wood, metal or other materials with a drill
facts.form: kit of several hole saws with mandrels, pilot drills and a case, put up together

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8202 covers blades for saws of all kinds; chapter 82 note 1 covers articles with a base metal working part
GRI 3(b): kit of hole saws (8202), pilot drills (8207) and mandrels/toolholders (8466) cannot go to 8206 (which covers only headings 8202-8205); hole saws give the essential character
GRI 6: 8202.99 other saw blades, single 10-digit line

rejected_alternatives.reason: heading 8206 covers sets of tools of headings 8202 to 8205 only; the kit includes drill bits and mandrels of 8207/8466
pilot drills and drill bits are minor components; hole saws give the essential character
mandrels are toolholders, minor components of the set
carry case is only packing and does not give the essential character

missing_facts: relative value of hole saws versus mandrels and pilot drills
classification.rationale: Hole saws are saw blades of heading 8202, residual subheading 8202.99. The kit mixes headings 8202, 8207 and 8466 so 8206 is unavailable; GRI 3(b) assigns the set to the hole saws as the component giving essential character. Rulings seen (R01195, L83289) concerned 8206 tool kits of different composition and were not relied on.
